_help: Difficulty profiles (Skillz). A map picks one through data/maps.json -> maps[].difficulty (arena=easy, rustwell_foundry=medium, lockout_substation=hard; a missing field means 'default'). Difficulty.apply_to_main(main) scales main.gd's wave exports: *_mult multiply the base value, *_add add to it. 'easy' is exactly the current tuning (all 1.0 / 0), so the Arena plays as before. wave: zombie stats and spawning. variants: wave_mix_round_offset = use the zombies.json wave_mix of round n+offset (Soldiers show up sooner); weight_mult multiplies a variant's weight. boss: cadence for data/bosses.json (first_round, every N rounds, count = base + per_cycle x cycles so far, capped at max_count; hp_mult/damage_mult on top of the boss's own stats). rewards: xp_mult (match XP), loot_rarity_bias (each rarity tier's drop weight x (1+bias)^tier: 0 = unchanged, 0.3 = Mythic weight x2.86), rare_currency_drop_mult (read by the Armory currency drop, coming with attachments), points_mult (kept at 1.0; points are tuned in economy.json).
